# ParallelLingvo

> ParallelLingvo is a multilingual vocabulary learning application supporting 11 languages. Learners can choose three or more supported languages and keep vocabulary, translations, pronunciation, difficult-word review, and progress connected around the same concept.

Canonical public website: https://parallellingvo.app/
Learning application: https://learn.iovenko.eu/
Source repository: https://github.com/ViktorIovenko/Learn_English_and_Dutch

## Supported languages and localized landing pages

- English (EN): https://parallellingvo.app/
- Nederlands / Dutch (NL): https://parallellingvo.app/nl/
- Русский / Russian (RU): https://parallellingvo.app/ru/
- Deutsch / German (DE): https://parallellingvo.app/de/
- Français / French (FR): https://parallellingvo.app/fr/
- Español / Spanish (ES): https://parallellingvo.app/es/
- Italiano / Italian (IT): https://parallellingvo.app/it/
- Português / Portuguese (PT): https://parallellingvo.app/pt/
- Polski / Polish (PL): https://parallellingvo.app/pl/
- 中文（普通话）/ Chinese Mandarin (ZH): https://parallellingvo.app/zh/
- 日本語 / Japanese (JA): https://parallellingvo.app/ja/

Each landing page is server-delivered HTML with its own canonical URL, language metadata and hreflang links. The visible navigation uses a compact language dropdown.

## Learning model

ParallelLingvo is designed for parallel multilingual vocabulary study. A learner can choose three or more supported languages and attach their translations to the same vocabulary concept instead of maintaining a separate bilingual deck for each pair.

Core workflow:

Lesson -> vocabulary concept -> multiple language forms -> examples or pronunciation -> learning status.
